references.text: Malachi prophesies about one who will come to turn many of the children of Israel back to the Lord their God, reflecting John the Baptist's role as described in Luke.
Daniel speaks of a time when many will be purified and turned to righteousness, which can be seen as a precursor to John the Baptist's ministry.
Isaiah prophesies about a voice in the wilderness preparing the way for the Lord, a direct connection to John the Baptist's role.
Acts confirms John the Baptist's role in turning people back to God, in line with the prophecies.
